name: astro-payload-app
description: Watch brand website: Payload CMS (apps/cms) + Astro frontend (apps/web)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/cms install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/cms run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.types:sync: npm --prefix apps/cms run generate:types && node scripts/sync-types.mjs
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/cms run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run check
